Q5735.reason: A plaintiff cannot remove her own state case under 28 U.S.C. §1441(a), which allows only the defendant to remove, so the court must remand the entire case.

Q5750.reason: Visual impairment making screens hard to read is the most direct reason to take care with internet-only information for people over 65.

Q5130.reason: A waggling earlobe with each beat is a classic arterial sign, while positive hepatojugular reflux and posture-dependent or root-of-neck-sensitive pulsations point to venous origin.
